name: agentmailer
description: Give AI agents isolated email inboxes and safe workflows for reading, drafting, and sending mail.

interface.shortDescription: Email inboxes and workflows for AI agents
interface.longDescription: Create isolated agent inboxes, search complete email threads, prepare drafts, and send or reply after explicit approval through AgentMailer's hosted MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Show my AgentMailer inboxes and summarize what each one is for.
Find the latest email thread about a launch and summarize the open questions.
